world: a band of hunter-gatherers 40,000 years ago in a green limestone river valley in what is now France in early spring, their camp under a rock overhang above the river
empty: a wild place 40,000 years ago in a limestone river valley in what is now France, completely empty of people, nobody anywhere in the frame, no modern objects, no paths, no fences, no clothing

light.D: only the light the place really has: cool early spring daylight under a pale sky, fresh green grass and bare trees with first buds
light.E: only the light the place really has: the last soft light of a spring dusk mixed with the warm glow of the camp fire from off frame, everything clearly readable
light.N: only the light the place really has: the warm orange glow of a camp fire from off frame lighting faces and hands, moonlight on the rock behind, exposure bright enough that faces, clothes and surroundings stay clearly readable
light.M: only the light the place really has: cold misty spring morning light over the river
